sloka: सततम् राजवृत्ते हि ज्येष्ठो राज्येऽभिषिच्यते ।राज्ञामेतत्समम् तत्स्यादिक्ष्वाकूणाम् विशेषतः ॥२-७३-२२॥
transliteration: satatam rājavṛtte hi jyeṣṭho rājye'bhiṣicyate ।rājñāmetatsamam tatsyādikṣvākūṇām viśeṣataḥ ॥2-73-22॥

translations.english: ﻿ According to the established law of royalty, the eldest son is invariably crowned in the kingdom. This is true of all kings. This is a special tradition of the kings of the Ikshvaku race.
